fields.title: 📖 Imām Mālik: Whoever says that the Qurʾān is created
fields.body:
🖋️ It is transmitted **from Imām Mālik** that he gave a very severe general classification concerning the statement “The Qurʾān is created”:

***“The statement that the Qurʾān is created was rejected by the Imāms in general as Kufr.”***

al-Lālakāʾī places this section expressly among the transmitted Fatwā statements about the one who says: **“The Qurʾān is created.”** Mālik and further Imāms are named in it.

🌙 **Conclusion:** This is a general judgment upon a **statement of Kufr** in the ʿAqīdah: the Qurʾān is the Word of Allah and is not created. The general judgment upon the statement must still be distinguished from applying it to a specific person.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Lālakāʾī, Šarḥ Uṣūl Iʿtiqād Ahl as-Sunnah wa-l-Jamāʿah, Bāb Jamāʿ Tawḥīd Allāh..., Abschnitt: 'Siyāq mā ruwiya ʿamman aftā fī man qāla: al-Qurʾān makhlūq', in der Shamela/Dār-Ṭaybah-Ausgabe: Teil 2, ab S. 345; die von dir genannte Druckstelle: Teil 2, S. 276–277, muss gegen deine Ausgabe abgeglichen werden.
